tldr: Mars in the 7th house: drive becomes personal through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
body:
With Mars in the 7th house, this part of you pushes through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict. Mars describes drive, anger, courage, desire, defense, and the will to act. In practice, this brings attention to the one-to-one dynamics that show you how you meet others and how you let yourself be met.

When this placement is supported, relationship patterns can become clearer while there is still room to choose differently. Mars can become courage, initiative, stamina, desire, and the ability to move when something matters.

When it is strained, you may hand too much power to the other person or make them carry the whole story. The harder pattern can show up as reactivity, conflict, burnout, or acting before the real target is clear.
gift: courage, initiative, stamina, desire, and the ability to move when something matters expressed through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
challenge: reactivity, conflict, burnout, or acting before the real target is clear around partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
